program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define guide-bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 7)))
             (define gr0 (first guide-bb))
             (define gc0 (second guide-bb))
             (define gr1 (third guide-bb))
             (define gc1 (fourth guide-bb))
             (define glyphs
               (filter (lambda (obj)
                         (and (!= (obj-color obj) 5) (!= (obj-color obj) 7)))
                       (objects g 5)))
             (define selected
               (find-first (lambda (obj)
                             (let ((ctr (obj-center obj)))
                               (and
                                 (>= (first ctr) gr0)
                                 (<= (first ctr) gr1)
                                 (>= (second ctr) gc0)
                                 (<= (second ctr) gc1))))
                           glyphs))
             (crop-object g selected)))))
